note: Atom ports below are CTRL.000.002 block ports routed by Quartus; none of these atoms sets a block, inverter or option bit except the CRC divider.

quartus_behaviour.jtag_tdo_unconnected: Error 176551: Destination of port TDO in JTAG block must be a pin
quartus_behaviour.jtag_tdoutap_connected: Error 176304: JTAG block does not support input port TDOUTAP
quartus_behaviour.jtag_core_ports_constant: routed as constants from the fabric (CORECTL_JTAG, NTDOPINENA, TCKCORE via TDMUX, TMSCORE, TDICORE)
quartus_behaviour.chipid_fabric_clock: clk from a register routes TDMUX -> CLOCK_CHIPID; a global clock routes TCLK.000.002.0000
quartus_behaviour.crcerror_to_output_pin: Quartus places the pad on the dedicated CRC_ERROR pin Y19 (error 176283 for any other location) and sets CRC_ERROR_DETECTION_EN
quartus_behaviour.ENABLE_CRC_ERROR_PIN ON: CRC_ERROR_DETECTION_EN 1 (oram 2.13), CRC_DIVIDE_ORDER from ERROR_CHECK_FREQUENCY_DIVISOR, Y19 open-drain output, DATAOUT.0 and OEIN.0 inverted, INPUT_REG4_SEL SEL_LOCKED_DPA
quartus_behaviour.STRATIX_JTAG_USER_CODE alone: ignored: usercode is the Quartus checksum (USE_CHECKSUM_AS_USERCODE defaults ON)
quartus_behaviour.USE_CHECKSUM_AS_USERCODE OFF: JTAG_ID ffffffff (Mistral default, current nextpnr output)
quartus_behaviour.ENABLE_DEVICE_WIDE_RESET ON: oram 6.4 = 0 (DEVICE_WIDE_RESET_EN 0); DEV_CLRn AB23 input, 1.8 V (IOCSR_STD NVR_LOW), no pull-up
quartus_behaviour.ENABLE_DEVICE_WIDE_OE ON: oram 6.5 = 0 (ALLOW_DEVICE_WIDE_OUTPUT_ENABLE_DIS 0); DEV_OE AC24 input, 1.8 V (NVR_LOW), no pull-up
quartus_behaviour.ENABLE_INIT_DONE_OUTPUT ON: oram 6.3 = 0 (Mistral calls it RELEASE_CLEARS_BEFORE_TRISTATES_DIS); INIT_DONE AA20 open-drain 3.3-V LVTTL output
quartus_behaviour.ENABLE_NCEO_OUTPUT ON: oram 2.19 = 0 (NCEO_DIS 0); nCEO AE25 push-pull output, DATAOUT.0 and OEIN.0 inverted
quartus_behaviour.START_UP_CLOCK: decodes overlap: bits 6.3/6.4/6.5 of START_UP_CLOCK are the INIT_DONE, DEV_CLRn and DEV_OE enables
quartus_behaviour.dedicated pins without STRATIX_DEVICE_IO: identical decode for DEV_CLRn, INIT_DONE and nCEO

RESERVE_ALL_UNUSED_PINS_WEAK_PULLUP.AS INPUT TRI-STATED: USE_WEAK_PULLUP 0 on every unused pad of the 315 GPIO pads (dedicated configuration and JTAG pads excluded)
RESERVE_ALL_UNUSED_PINS_WEAK_PULLUP.AS INPUT TRI-STATED WITH BUS-HOLD: USE_WEAK_PULLUP 0 and USE_BUS_HOLD 1 on the same pads
RESERVE_ALL_UNUSED_PINS_WEAK_PULLUP.AS OUTPUT DRIVING GROUND / AN UNSPECIFIE: DRIVE_STRENGTH PROG_GND plus GPIO and HMC inverter changes; not implemented

quartus_behaviour.ON_CHIP_BITSTREAM_DECOMPRESSION ON: COMPRESSION_DIS 0 and OPT_B ffffff40.2dffffff, identical to nextpnr --compress-rbf (assignment still ignored by nextpnr)
quartus_behaviour.cyclonev_rublock / cyclonev_asmiblock: need STRATIXV_CONFIGURATION_SCHEME Active Serial (errors 169310 / 176289); AS sets undecoded option bits oram 5.20 5.21 5.23 6.10 (6.09 with ASMI) 6.36 6.37
